papers.title: Base-pair resolution conservation data improves cell type specific sequence-to-expression prediction
papers.summary: Abstract Motivation Genomic sequence-to-activity models can decipher gene regulatory mechanisms and predict the functional impact of regulatory variants. However, current models struggle to integrate information from sequences outside promoters, especially information from cell type specific regulatory elements. Results Here, we propose incorporating base-pair resolution evolutionary conservation data into genomic sequence-to-expression predictors. We explore two training strategies—training from scratch or fine-tuning an existing sequence-only model with additional conservation input. We find that in both cases, base-pair resolution conservation data improves cell type specific sequence-to-expression prediction, with training from scratch yielding the greatest benefit. The improvement in cell type specific expression prediction can be attributed in part to the fact that models trained on sequence and conservation data learn to better recognize cell type specific regulatory elements than models trained on sequence alone. Availability Code is available at https://github.com/ni-lab/basenji-phyloP
papers.abstract:
MOTIVATION: Genomic sequence-to-activity models can decipher gene regulatory mechanisms and predict the functional impact of regulatory variants. However, current models struggle to integrate information from sequences outside promoters, especially information from cell type specific regulatory elements.

RESULTS: Here, we propose incorporating base-pair resolution evolutionary conservation data into genomic sequence-to-expression predictors. We explore two training strategies-training from scratch or fine-tuning an existing sequence-only model with additional conservation input. We find that in both cases, base-pair resolution conservation data improves cell type specific sequence-to-expression prediction, with training from scratch yielding the greatest benefit. The improvement in cell type specific expression prediction can be attributed in part to the fact that models trained on sequence and conservation data learn to better recognize cell type specific regulatory elements than models trained on sequence alone.

AVAILABILITY: Code is available at https://github.com/ni-lab/basenji-phyloP.

SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.

papers.llm_research_question_zh: 动机：从基因组序列到功能表达的转化模型能够帮助人们解读基因调控机制，并预测调控变异对基因功能的影响。

结果：本文建议将具有碱基对分辨率的进化保守性数据纳入基因组序列与表达预测模型中。

papers.llm_rss_summary_zh:
**摘要**  
**动机**：基因组序列与功能关联的模型能够帮助人们解析基因调控机制，并预测调控变异对基因功能的影响。然而，现有的模型难以整合来自启动子区域之外的序列信息，尤其是那些与特定细胞类型相关的调控元件所携带的信息。  
**结果**：本研究提出将具有碱基对分辨率的进化保守性数据纳入基因组序列到表达功能的预测模型中。我们尝试了两种训练方法：从头开始构建新模型，或在对现有仅基于序列数据的模型进行微调时添加这些保守性信息。实验结果表明，在这两种情况下，这类数据都能显著提升针对特定细胞类型的序列到表达功能预测的准确性，其中从头开始训练的方法效果最为显著。这种改进主要源于：同时利用序列数据和保守性数据进行训练的模型，能够比仅依赖序列数据的模型更有效地识别与特定细胞类型相关的调控元件。  
**代码获取方式**：相关代码可访问以下链接：https://github.com/ni-lab/basenji-phyloP

RESULTS: Here, we propose incorporating base-pair resolution evolutionary conservation data into genomic sequence-to-expression predictors. We explore two training strategies-training from scratch or fine-tuning an existing sequence-only model with additional conservation input. We find that in both cases, base-pair resolution conservation data improves cell type specific sequence-to-expression prediction, with training from scratch yielding the greatest benefit. The improvement in cell type specific expression prediction can be attributed in part to the fact that models trained on sequence and conservation data learn to better recognize cell type specific regulatory elements than models trained on sequence alone.

AVAILABILITY: Code is available at https://github.com/ni-lab/basenji-phyloP.

SUPPLEMENTARY INFORMATION: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.
